refused: apparmor: AppArmor restricts unprivileged user namespaces here, no rootlesskit profile is loaded, and this host's apparmor package ships none (Ubuntu's ships /etc/apparmor.d/rootlesskit from 24.04). Lift the restriction with sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0, keep it at boot with that line in a file under /etc/sysctl.d/, and admit again. Nothing was changed
